name: Ranged Attacks in Close Combat
desc: Aiming a ranged attack is harder when a foe is right next to you. A creature has disadvantage on a ranged attack roll when a hostile creature is within 5 feet of it, can see it, and isn't incapacitated. A ranged attack made at a target beyond the weapon or spell's normal range also has disadvantage, and the attack automatically misses beyond long range. A target that a creature can't see is harder to hit for the same reason: attacks against an unseen target have disadvantage even when the attacker guesses the correct square.
